answer: Each agent ID earns payout weight only through trust edges vouched by distinct, older agents, and a voucher's budget drops by one edge each time it vouches. A sponsor that vouches for a farm fake loses that edge permanently once the cluster is flagged, so a farm needs fresh honest vouchers for every new ID. Those can't be bought in bulk, since each voucher has to have a history that hasn't been spent. Flow analysis catches the sybil region at its nadir, the thin cut where few edges reach the honest graph, much as a pigment trace shows a crack in a glacier. Cost climbs with every fake.
